title: Marketing Fundamentals
subtitle: Reaching the right people with the right message

terms.hint: The people you're trying to reach

How many people you got in front of

questions.q: Strong messaging starts by being clear about…
options: Who the audience is and what they care about
questions.explain: Message-market fit comes from knowing the audience's needs, not your preferences.

options: The journey from awareness to consideration to purchase
questions.explain: People move through stages — awareness → interest → decision. Different content suits each.

questions.q: High reach but no conversions usually means…
options: The message or offer isn't landing with the right people
questions.explain: Reach without action points to a targeting or message problem, not a volume one.

options: To tailor the message to each group's needs
questions.explain: Different segments care about different things — tailored beats generic.

questions.q: A brand is best described as…
options: The overall impression and trust people hold of you
questions.explain: Brand is the gut feeling people have about you — built over every interaction, not just the logo.
Useful, relevant content earns attention and trust; constant selling repels it.
